selected_evidence.summary: Shows account creation, valid unit configuration, enablement, active state, configured user/group, executable, and live process UID 992 matching inventorysvc.
Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, system recovery, and the enabled active worker running as inventorysvc after restart.

commands.command:
install -d -m 0755 /etc/systemd/system && cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
LockPersonality=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service && systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service && systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service

printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service; pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service); printf 'main_pid=%s\n' "$pid"; ps -o pid=,ppid=,user=,group=,stat=,args= -p "$pid"; printf 'proc_uid='; awk '/^Uid:/{print $2}' "/proc/$pid/status"; printf 'unit_user='; systemctl show -p User --value inventory-worker.service; printf 'unit_exec='; systemctl show -p ExecStart --value inventory-worker.service
